..description: The root directory acts as the primary workspace for the Tostr project, housing the core analysis engine in 'src/tostr' while maintaining auxiliary configuration and resource management folders. The 'src/tostr' directory functions as the central architectural hub, orchestrating project indexing, semantic search, and LLM-driven code interpretation through a modular design that integrates AST parsing, persistent storage, and unified CLI/server interfaces.

src.description: The src/tostr directory serves as the core architectural hub for the Tostr codebase analysis engine. It encapsulates the entire lifecycle of project indexing, semantic search, and LLM-driven code interpretation. The architecture is modularized into foundational data models (core), language-specific AST parsing (languages), persistent state management (storage), and semantic analysis (semantic). It provides a unified command-line interface (cli/commands) and server-side orchestration (server) to maintain a synchronized, queryable representation of source code, supported by robust error handling, configuration management, and cross-cutting utility services.

src/tostr.description: The src/tostr directory serves as the core architectural hub for the Tostr codebase analysis engine. It encapsulates the entire lifecycle of project indexing, semantic search, and LLM-driven code interpretation. The architecture is modularized into foundational data models (core), language-specific AST parsing (languages), persistent state management (storage), and semantic analysis (semantic). It provides a unified command-line interface (cli/commands) and server-side orchestration (server) to maintain a synchronized, queryable representation of source code, supported by robust error handling, configuration management, and cross-cutting utility services.

src/tostr/agents.py.description: Manages the lifecycle of AI agent configuration profiles, providing mechanisms to inject, update, and remove system-level guidance blocks within project files. It utilizes a template-driven approach to maintain consistent agent behavior across different file formats, ensuring non-destructive modifications to existing user content.

src/tostr/agents.py#AgentProfile.description: Represents the configuration schema for an AI agent's system prompt and behavioral rules, defining how agent-specific instructions are persisted and managed within a project or global environment.

src/tostr/agents.py#_destination(...).description: Resolves the absolute filesystem path for an agent configuration based on the profile, target directory, and requested scope.

src/tostr/agents.py#_read_template(...).description: Reads and returns the content of a specified template file from the internal tostr.templates package resource.

src/tostr/agents.py#_render_body(...).description: Generates the formatted agent guidance string by loading a template and applying format-specific wrappers such as MDC frontmatter.

src/tostr/agents.py#_resolve(...).description: Retrieves an AgentProfile from the global registry by key, raising a TostrError if the key is unrecognized.

src/tostr/agents.py#_strip_block(...).description: Removes the Tostr-managed block from a string, preserving surrounding content and normalizing whitespace.

src/tostr/agents.py#_upsert_block(...).description: Inserts or updates a Tostr-managed block within a string, ensuring the block is correctly delimited and surrounding text is preserved.

src/tostr/agents.py#add_agent(...).description: Installs or updates agent guidance into a target file, performing idempotent, non-destructive writes that preserve existing user content.

src/tostr/agents.py#list_agents(...).description: Returns a list of formatted strings summarizing all supported agents, their labels, target paths, and available installation scopes.

src/tostr/agents.py#remove_agent(...).description: Uninstalls agent guidance by removing the managed block from shared files or deleting dedicated configuration files, returning a status report.

src/tostr/cli.py.description: Provides the command-line interface (CLI) for the Tostr project, orchestrating project indexing, semantic search, structural visualization, and AI agent integration. It leverages Rich for terminal output, manages SQLite-based persistence, and implements file-system monitoring to maintain an up-to-date codebase representation.

src/tostr/cli.py#TostrHighlighter.description: A specialized syntax highlighter for the .tost human-readable format, extending RegexHighlighter to apply visual styling to UIDs, multi-line comments, structural line references, dependency edges, and section headers.

src/tostr/cli.py#_render_inspect(...).description: Formats and prints an InspectResult object or raw string to the console, applying syntax highlighting, structural grouping for code members, and rendering source code bodies with line numbers.

src/tostr/cli.py#_render_search(...).description: Renders a list of search results to the console, displaying IDs, types, and similarity distances with formatted styling.

src/tostr/cli.py#_render_skeleton(...).description: Recursively constructs a Rich Tree representation of a project skeleton, styling UIDs and formatting short-form identifiers.

src/tostr/cli.py#_run_watcher_thread(....description: Executes the file watcher in an isolated asynchronous event loop within a background thread.

src/tostr/cli.py#_short_uid(...).description: Trims the file path prefix from a code structure's UID, retaining only the '#member' identifier for classes and methods.

src/tostr/cli.py#add_agent_cmd(...).description: Registers Tostr guidance into specified AI agent configuration files (e.g., .clinerules) by upserting a managed block, supporting both project-local and global scopes.

src/tostr/cli.py#clean(...).description: Cleans the project by removing the generated .tostr/ cache, with an optional flag to purge configuration files.

src/tostr/cli.py#export(...).description: Exports project descriptions to a lockfile (tostr.lock.json) to facilitate environment seeding without re-invoking the LLM.

src/tostr/cli.py#init(...).description: Initializes a Tostr project by scaffolding necessary configuration files (tostr.toml, .tostrignore) in the target directory.

src/tostr/cli.py#inspect(...).description: Outputs AST details for specified code structures, supporting optional body inclusion and pretty-printing.

src/tostr/cli.py#parse(...).description: Parses the target project directory to build or update the SQLite database, managing embedding model initialization, progress tracking, and asynchronous execution of the parsing pipeline based on user-defined LLM and caching strategies.

src/tostr/cli.py#remove_agent_cmd(...).description: Removes Tostr-managed guidance blocks from AI agent configuration files or deletes dedicated agent files, preserving user-defined content.

src/tostr/cli.py#search(...).description: Performs a semantic search across the project by embedding the query and retrieving the top K matching code structures.

src/tostr/cli.py#skeleton(...).description: Generates and displays a hierarchical skeleton of the project structure based on a provided subpath and depth constraints.

src/tostr/cli.py#start_mcp(...).description: Starts the MCP server instance and awaits agent initialization.

src/tostr/cli.py#status(...).description: Displays the current status of the Tostr database, including file path, size, last update timestamp, and entity statistics.

src/tostr/cli.py#watch(...).description: Monitors the project directory for file changes and triggers asynchronous database updates.

src/tostr/commands.py.description: Provides the core command-line and asynchronous orchestration layer for the Tostr project, managing project initialization, AST parsing, database lifecycle, file system monitoring, and LLM-driven code analysis. It coordinates interactions between the file system, SQLite-backed cache, and LLM providers to maintain a synchronized, queryable representation of the codebase.

src/tostr/commands.py#_append_gitignore(.description: Idempotently adds the .tostr/ directory to the project's .gitignore file, creating the file if necessary only within active git repositories.

src/tostr/commands.py#_build_ast_async(..description: Constructs an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) by parsing project files, resolving dependencies, and optionally generating LLM-based descriptions and embeddings.

src/tostr/commands.py#_guarded_write(....description: Executes a database-mutating function off-loop, serializing access via an optional lock and skipping execution if the task has been superseded by a newer operation.

src/tostr/commands.py#_verify_db_exists(.description: Validates the existence and compatibility of the Tostr database at the specified project path, raising errors if the database is missing or uses an outdated schema.

src/tostr/commands.py#clean_db(...).description: Removes generated cache files and optionally purges authored configuration files to perform a full project reset.

src/tostr/commands.py#export_lockfile(...description: Snapshots project descriptions and optionally vectors into a version-controlled lockfile to enable cold-start seeding without re-running LLM inference.

src/tostr/commands.py#get_cached_embeddi.description: Initializes and returns an EmbeddingClient configured with an ONNX strategy, ensuring the underlying model graph is instantiated only once per process.

src/tostr/commands.py#get_llm_client(....description: Instantiates an LLMProvider client based on the provided project configuration and optional progress tracker, defaulting to Gemini if no specific strategy is defined.

src/tostr/commands.py#get_status(...).description: Compiles a diagnostic summary of the project's Tostr database, including file system paths, storage metrics, and counts of stored structures and edges.

src/tostr/commands.py#init_project(...).description: Scaffolds the project directory with default configuration files (tostr.toml, .tostrignore) and ensures the .tostr/ directory is ignored by version control.

src/tostr/commands.py#inspect_async(...).description: Retrieves and formats structural information for specified IDs or UIDs from the project cache, optionally including full source bodies.

src/tostr/commands.py#parse_async(...).description: Orchestrates a full project parse and cache build, including database version validation, configuration-driven LLM strategy selection, and AST persistence.

src/tostr/commands.py#process_file_delet.description: Removes all database entries associated with a deleted file or directory subtree to ensure cache integrity and prevent stale data.

src/tostr/commands.py#process_single_fil.description: Updates the project cache for a single file by reparsing, resolving dependencies, and performing incremental writes to the database while maintaining consistency with existing project-wide data.

src/tostr/commands.py#resolve_uid_to_id(.description: Resolves a unique identifier (UID) to its internal database ID by querying the project's SQLite store.

src/tostr/commands.py#search_async(...).description: Performs a semantic vector search across the project database to find code structures matching a natural language query, optionally filtered by type.

src/tostr/commands.py#skeleton_async(....description: Generates a hierarchical skeleton representation of a specific project subtree by loading relevant structures into the cache and dumping their metadata.

src/tostr/commands.py#watch_async(...).description: Monitors a target directory for file system changes using awatch, dispatching asynchronous tasks to process additions, modifications, or deletions while maintaining a serialized write lock to ensure database integrity.

src/tostr/config.py.description: Orchestrates project configuration management and ignore-rule resolution for the tostr utility. It integrates settings from configuration files and filesystem-based ignore templates, providing a unified interface for language-specific defaults and path-based exclusion logic.

src/tostr/config.py#ProjectConfig.description: Manages project-level configuration and file-ignore logic by aggregating settings from tostr.toml, .tostrignore, and hardcoded defaults. It provides a centralized interface for resolving project-specific parameters like language and LLM strategies while enforcing path-based exclusion rules.

src/tostr/config.py#ProjectConfig.__init.description: Initializes the configuration state by loading the toml file, building path ignore specifications, and applying CLI overrides.

src/tostr/config.py#ProjectConfig._init_.description: Constructs a pathspec object for file exclusion, prioritizing a local .tostrignore file if present, otherwise falling back to language-specific default ignore patterns.
Parses and returns the project configuration from a tostr.toml file located at the project root, returning an empty dictionary if the file is missing.

src/tostr/config.py#ProjectConfig.is_ign.description: Determines if a given file path should be ignored by checking it against hardcoded defaults and project-specific ignore rules, normalizing paths relative to the project root.

src/tostr/config.py#ProjectConfig.langua.description: Returns the active programming language, prioritizing CLI overrides over the toml configuration or defaulting to 'auto'.

src/tostr/config.py#ProjectConfig.llm_op.description: Extracts provider-specific LLM configuration options from the toml file, excluding the strategy identifier.

src/tostr/config.py#ProjectConfig.llm_st.description: Resolves the LLM strategy by prioritizing CLI overrides, then the toml configuration, defaulting to 'gemini'.

src/tostr/config.py#_languages_for(...).description: Resolves a language identifier into a list of concrete language strings, expanding 'auto' to all supported languages via the LanguageProvider.

src/tostr/config.py#default_ignore_text(.description: Generates the content for a default .tostrignore file by concatenating language-specific ignore templates with descriptive headers.

src/tostr/config.py#language_default_ign.description: Retrieves a consolidated list of ignore patterns from language-specific default template files for use as fallback configuration.

src/tostr/core.description: Defines the foundational architectural abstractions and hierarchical data models for codebase representation. It provides a graph-based structure for AST-derived components, a factory-based deserialization framework for object reconstruction, and centralized registry management for language-specific providers and LLM client strategies, alongside standardized project path resolution.

src/tostr/core/__init__.py.description: Package initialization module for the tostr.core namespace. Exposes core architectural abstractions including structural models (BaseStruct, BaseCodeStruct, Directory, BaseClass, BaseField, BaseMethod, BaseFile), the LanguageProvider interface, and ProjectPaths utility for project-level path management.

src/tostr/core/builders.py.description: Implements a factory-based deserialization framework for mapping serialized dictionary representations and AST nodes into a structured hierarchy of code components (Files, Directories, Classes, Methods, Fields). The module provides a unified registry-backed builder pattern to reconstruct project metadata and structural attributes, facilitating the transformation of raw source analysis into typed, navigable object models.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#BaseBuilder.description: An abstract factory base class that provides a unified interface for instantiating specialized builder objects for various structural components within a registry-managed system.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#BaseBuilder._.description: Initializes the builder with a reference to the shared Registry instance used for component tracking.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#BaseBuilder.b.description: Instantiates and returns a new BaseClassBuilder instance initialized with the current registry.
Instantiates and returns a new DirectoryBuilder instance initialized with the current registry.
Instantiates and returns a new BaseFieldBuilder instance initialized with the current registry.
Instantiates and returns a new BaseFileBuilder instance initialized with the current registry.
Instantiates and returns a new BaseMethodBuilder instance initialized with the current registry.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#BaseBuilder.w.description: Routes the request to the appropriate builder factory method based on the provided struct_type string identifier.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#BaseClassBuil.description: A specialized builder class for instantiating BaseClass objects from dictionary representations, facilitating the reconstruction of code structure metadata within the project registry.
Constructs and returns a BaseClass instance by mapping dictionary keys to object attributes, resolving file paths relative to the project root and deserializing dependency lists.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#BaseCodeStruc.description: Abstract builder implementation for transforming AST nodes into structured code representations, serving as a specialized factory for BaseStruct subclasses within the structural analysis pipeline.
Parses a provided AST node into a concrete BaseClass instance, optionally linking it to a parent structure to maintain hierarchical context.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#BaseFieldBuil.description: A specialized builder class responsible for instantiating BaseField objects from dictionary representations, facilitating the reconstruction of code structure metadata from serialized formats.
Constructs and returns a BaseField instance by parsing a dictionary, resolving file paths relative to the project root, and deserializing dependency strings.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#BaseFileBuild.description: A specialized builder class for instantiating BaseFile objects from filesystem paths or serialized dictionary representations, integrating them into the project registry.
Constructs a BaseFile instance from a dictionary, mapping metadata fields including dependencies, line numbers, and content hashes while resolving the file path relative to the project root.
Instantiates a BaseFile object from a given filesystem path, assigning a unique identifier based on the relative project path and associating it with the current registry.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#BaseMethodBui.description: A specialized builder class for instantiating BaseMethod objects from dictionary representations, facilitating the deserialization of method metadata and structural attributes within the project registry context.
Constructs a BaseMethod instance by mapping dictionary keys to object attributes, resolving file paths relative to the project root and parsing JSON-encoded dependency strings.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#BaseStructBui.description: Abstract base class defining a factory pattern for deserializing dictionary data into structured BaseStruct objects, utilizing a shared Registry for dependency resolution.
Initializes the builder with a Registry instance to facilitate lookups and dependency injection during the construction process.
Deserializes a dictionary into a concrete BaseStruct instance, requiring implementation by subclasses to define specific mapping logic.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#DirectoryBuil.description: A specialized builder class for instantiating Directory objects from dictionary representations, handling path resolution, metadata assignment, and deserialization of dependency strings.
Constructs and returns a Directory instance by resolving the provided path relative to the project root, assigning metadata, and parsing JSON-encoded inbound and outbound dependency strings.

src/tostr/core/builders.py#line_bounds(..description: Calculates the 1-indexed start and end line numbers for a given tree-sitter node, adjusting for 0-indexed row offsets and exclusive end-point semantics to accurately reflect the source code span.

src/tostr/core/models.py.description: Defines the core hierarchical data models for representing a codebase as a graph structure. It provides a foundational set of abstract and concrete classes—including BaseStruct, BaseCodeStruct, BaseFile, Directory, BaseClass, BaseMethod, and BaseField—that encapsulate metadata, positional information, dependency tracking, and serialization logic necessary for AST-based analysis and LLM-driven context management.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseClass.description: Represents a structural definition of a class within a codebase, managing inheritance, field types, and dependency resolution while providing mechanisms for documentation skeletonization and serialization.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseClass._clea.description: Resets internal caches, specifically clearing the potential parents cache, and propagates the clear operation to the superclass.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseClass.impor.description: Retrieves the list of import identifiers associated with the class by delegating to the parent structure.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseClass.needs.description: Evaluates whether the class or any of its non-field children require a description, returning true if any documentation is missing.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseClass.resol.description: Resolves all class dependencies, including imports, parent inheritance, and field types, by utilizing the registry resolver and updating the internal dependency graph.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseClass.skele.description: Generates a string representation of the class structure by replacing child nodes with their respective signatures and descriptions, requiring an associated AST node.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseClass.to_di.description: Serializes the class instance into a dictionary format, including type metadata, enum constants, and inheritance information.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseCodeStruct.description: Represents a structural metadata container for source code units, capturing positional data, signatures, and raw content for AST-based analysis and LLM context management.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseCodeStruct..description: Serializes the instance into a dictionary, appending type-specific metadata including signature, body, and line boundaries to the base structure representation.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseField.description: Represents a base structural definition for fields within a code-based schema, extending BaseCodeStruct to provide standardized serialization and hierarchical organization via a children dictionary.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseField.to_di.description: Serializes the field instance into a dictionary, injecting a 'field' type identifier and the specific field_type attribute into the base structural data.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseFile.description: Represents a source code file structure within a project hierarchy, encapsulating metadata such as package declarations, imports, source line bounds, and a diff hash for change tracking. It serves as a specialized node in the codebase model, providing a serialized representation of file-level attributes.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseFile.to_dic.description: Serializes the file instance into a dictionary, augmenting the base structure with file-specific fields including imports, body content, line range, package name, and diff hash.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseMethod.description: Represents a structural definition of a method within a codebase, managing dependency resolution and serialization metadata. It serves as a base class for tracking method arity, internal dependencies, and hierarchical relationships within a registry-managed environment.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseMethod.reso.description: Triggers the dependency resolution process for the method by invoking the associated registry resolver and updates the global progress tracker upon completion.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseMethod.to_d.description: Serializes the method instance into a dictionary, appending method-specific metadata including arity, dependency names, and type classification to the base structure.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.description: An abstract base class representing a node in a hierarchical codebase graph, providing infrastructure for dependency tracking, structural nesting, and metadata management. It serves as the foundational unit for representing files, classes, methods, and fields, enabling graph-based analysis and serialization.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.__eq.description: Determines equality between two BaseStruct instances based on their unique ID.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.__ha.description: Returns the hash of the struct's unique ID for set and dictionary operations.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.__po.description: Initializes the unique ID by hashing the UID upon object creation.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.__st.description: Returns a string representation of the struct using its class name and unique identifier.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct._cle.description: Resets the internal caches for child nodes and type-specific lookups.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.add_.description: Registers a child node to the current struct, updates the parent-child relationship, and invalidates internal caches.
Establishes a hard dependency between this struct and a target, updating both inbound/outbound sets and propagating the dependency to parent containers.
Establishes a fuzzy dependency between this struct and a target, updating both inbound/outbound fuzzy sets and propagating to parent containers.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.all_.description: Aggregates and returns all child nodes from the internal children dictionary, utilizing a cache for performance.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.clas.description: Returns a list of all child nodes that are instances of BaseClass.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.dire.description: Returns a list of all child nodes that are instances of Directory.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.edge.description: Generates a set of graph edges representing dependency relationships and parent-child hierarchy.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.exte.description: Extracts the file extension from the associated path, returning an empty string if no path is defined.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.fiel.description: Returns a list of all child nodes that are instances of BaseField.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.file.description: Returns a list of all child nodes that are instances of BaseFile.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.from.description: Constructs a new instance of the class from a dictionary, preserving the ID if provided.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.get_.description: Retrieves child nodes filtered by a specific class type, utilizing an internal cache to optimize repeated lookups.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.impa.description: Calculates a heuristic impact score based on the sum of inbound dependencies and total child count.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.inbo.description: Returns a cached list of formatted strings representing all inbound dependencies, including both standard and fuzzy links.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.meth.description: Returns a list of all child nodes that are instances of BaseMethod.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.outb.description: Returns a cached list of formatted strings representing all outbound dependencies, including both standard and fuzzy links.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.reso.description: Recursively triggers dependency resolution for all child nodes and advances the registry progress tracker.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.set_.description: Assigns a parent to the current struct, preventing circular references by checking for self-assignment.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.to_d.description: Serializes the struct's core attributes, dependency strings, and metadata into a dictionary format.

src/tostr/core/models.py#BaseStruct.to_j.description: Serializes the struct to a JSON string representation.

src/tostr/core/models.py#Directory.description: Represents a directory structure within a project registry, extending BaseStruct to manage hierarchical file system metadata, unique identification, and state tracking via diff hashes.

src/tostr/core/models.py#Directory.__ini.description: Initializes the directory instance, resolving the display name from the provided path and registering the object within the project hierarchy.

src/tostr/core/models.py#Directory.to_di.description: Serializes the directory instance into a dictionary, appending type metadata and the current diff_hash to the base structure representation.

src/tostr/core/paths.py.description: Manages and resolves standardized file system paths for a project, including configuration, ignore files, lock files, and internal cache directories.

src/tostr/core/paths.py#ProjectPaths.description: Manages and resolves standardized file system paths for a project, including configuration, ignore files, lock files, and internal cache directories.

src/tostr/core/paths.py#ProjectPaths.__i.description: Initializes the project path structure by defining standard locations for configuration, ignore rules, lock files, and the internal cache directory.

src/tostr/core/paths.py#ProjectPaths.rel.description: Computes the relative path of a given input path against the project root, falling back to OS-level relative path calculation if standard path resolution fails.

src/tostr/core/providers.py.description: Provides centralized factory infrastructure for the application, managing the instantiation of LLM client strategies and language-specific build components. It facilitates modularity by decoupling client configuration and language-specific logic from the core execution flow through dynamic resolution and registry management.

src/tostr/core/providers.py#LLMProvider.description: Factory class responsible for resolving, configuring, and instantiating LLM client strategies based on project configuration and environment variables.

src/tostr/core/providers.py#LLMProvider..description: Instantiates a specific LLM strategy class by dynamically importing the module, filtering configuration options against the strategy's constructor signature, and injecting required credentials.
Retrieves the GEMINI_API_KEY from the environment, raising an APIKeyError if the key is missing.
Resolves the LLM strategy from project configuration and returns an initialized LLMClient, or returns None if the strategy is set to 'none'.

src/tostr/core/providers.py#LanguageProv.description: Acts as a central factory and registry manager for language-specific build and dependency resolution components, mapping file extensions to their respective implementation classes via dynamic module loading.
Determines if a specific language is permitted based on the registry configuration, returning true if the mode is 'auto' or matches the target language.
Dynamically imports and instantiates a builder class for the specified file extension, returning None if the extension is unsupported or restricted by the current registry configuration.

Instantiates and returns the appropriate dependency resolver for a given file extension by dynamically importing the class defined in the language map, defaulting to a base no-op resolver if no specific mapping exists.
Maps a file extension string to its corresponding language identifier using a predefined extension map.

src/tostr/exceptions.py.description: Defines the hierarchical exception framework for the Tostr library, establishing TostrError as the base class for all domain-specific errors. It provides specialized exception types for handling failures related to cache versioning, API authentication, resource location, and configuration validation, ensuring consistent error propagation and granular diagnostic reporting across the application.

src/tostr/exceptions.py#APIKeyError.description: Represents a specialized exception thrown when an API key validation or authentication failure occurs within the Tostr framework.

src/tostr/exceptions.py#CacheFormatError.description: Represents a specialized exception indicating that the on-disk cache structure is incompatible with the current application build version, typically triggered by a mismatch in core.cache_version.

src/tostr/exceptions.py#ConfigError.description: Represents a specialized exception for configuration-related failures, specifically triggered when application settings are invalid, malformed, or contain unresolvable references such as unsupported LLM strategies.

src/tostr/exceptions.py#DatabaseNotFound.description: Represents a specialized exception thrown when a requested database resource cannot be located within the system, inheriting from TostrError to maintain consistent error handling patterns.

src/tostr/exceptions.py#TostrError.description: Serves as the root exception hierarchy for the Tostr domain, providing a unified base class for all custom error handling and exception propagation within the library.

src/tostr/graph.description: Core infrastructure for project-wide structural analysis and dependency graph management. Orchestrates the lifecycle of code parsing, metadata hydration, and semantic indexing through a centralized registry. Provides robust mechanisms for resolving symbolic references to concrete structural UIDs and supports extensible parsing engines for building searchable, context-aware representations of the codebase.

src/tostr/graph/__init__.py.description: Package initialization module for the graph sub-package, exposing core abstractions including BaseParser, Registry, and BaseDependencyResolver to facilitate dependency graph management and parsing logic.

src/tostr/graph/parser.py.description: An abstract base class for project parsing engines that orchestrates the discovery, structural mapping, dependency resolution, and semantic description of source code files. It manages the lifecycle of project metadata by integrating with a registry, optional caching mechanisms, LLM-based description providers, and embedding services to build a searchable project representation.

src/tostr/graph/parser.py#BaseParser.description: An abstract base class for project parsing engines that orchestrates the discovery, structural mapping, dependency resolution, and semantic description of source code files. It manages the lifecycle of project metadata by integrating with a registry, optional caching mechanisms, LLM-based description providers, and embedding services to build a searchable project representation.

src/tostr/graph/parser.py#BaseParser.__i.description: Initializes the parser with the project directory, optional LLM/embedder services, a central registry for structural storage, and a cache manager for persistence.

src/tostr/graph/parser.py#BaseParser._at.description: Re-links a standalone file into the project's directory hierarchy by recursively stubbing or creating parent directory structures to ensure the file remains connected to the project root.

src/tostr/graph/parser.py#BaseParser.fil.description: Retrieves a list of all file-type objects currently stored in the registry's UID map.

src/tostr/graph/parser.py#BaseParser.par.description: Executes the full parsing pipeline: traverses the file system, resolves dependencies, carries over cached data, and generates semantic descriptions for the project.
Identifies and invokes the appropriate language-specific builder to instantiate a file object from a given path, returning None if no builder is registered or the path is ignored.
Recursively traverses the file system starting from a given path, creating directory and file structures in the registry while respecting ignore rules.

src/tostr/graph/parser.py#BaseParser.res.description: Triggers the dependency resolution process starting from the registry root to establish inter-file relationships.
Asynchronously generates semantic descriptions and embeddings for the project structure using either an LLM or a fallback describer, utilizing cache/lockfile data to optimize performance.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py.description: Acts as the central in-memory repository for parsed and hydrated code structures, managing the object graph, dependency resolution providers, and project-wide configuration. It maintains distinct indexes for fresh and cached structs to ensure data integrity during incremental parsing and persistence operations.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.description: Acts as the central in-memory repository for parsed and hydrated code structures, managing the object graph, dependency resolution providers, and project-wide configuration. It maintains distinct indexes for fresh and cached structs to ensure data integrity during incremental parsing and persistence operations.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.__i.description: Initializes the registry with project paths, progress tracking, and configuration, setting up internal maps for parsed and hydrated structs.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry._fi.description: Performs a lookup for a struct by matching the exact UID or by treating the candidate as a trailing path segment.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.add.description: Registers a struct sourced from the cache, making it available for lookups and resolution without triggering pipeline progress or write-back.
Registers a newly parsed struct and enqueues its associated pipeline tasks (resolution, description, embedding) in the progress tracker.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.cla.description: Returns a list of all registered structs that are instances of BaseClass.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.evi.description: Removes all hydrated structs associated with a specific file path to prevent stale data from interfering with re-parsing.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.fie.description: Returns a list of all registered structs that are instances of BaseField.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.fil.description: Returns a list of all registered structs that are instances of BaseFile.

Retrieves a struct by its internal ID from the global ID map.
Retrieves a struct by its unique identifier, checking the parsed map first, then the hydrated map.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.lan.description: Returns the configured programming language, defaulting to 'java' if not specified.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.met.description: Returns a list of all registered structs that are instances of BaseMethod.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.pro.description: Returns the project root path from the associated path configuration.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.res.description: Resolves an import candidate to a struct using exact UID matching, path-suffix matching, or a fallback search for uniquely named definitions within the project.

src/tostr/graph/registry.py#Registry.uid.description: Provides a read-only merged view of all parsed and hydrated structs, prioritizing parsed versions in case of UID collisions.

src/tostr/graph/resolver.py.description: Resolves symbolic type and method references to concrete structural UIDs within an AST graph. It leverages a registry of normalized import candidates and inheritance chains to perform context-aware lookups, supporting both direct UID resolution and heuristic-based matching for method calls and class instantiations.

src/tostr/graph/resolver.py#BaseDependen.description: Resolves symbolic type and method references to concrete structural UIDs within an AST graph. It leverages a registry of normalized import candidates and inheritance chains to perform context-aware lookups, supporting both direct UID resolution and heuristic-based matching for method calls and class instantiations.
Initializes the resolver with a registry of known structs and sets the strict arity enforcement flag.
Traverses the AST from a given struct to collect all nested descendant nodes.
Walks up the AST parent chain to identify the enclosing file struct for a given node.
Searches the descendants of a scope to find a class matching the specified name.
Aggregates a list of potential scope UIDs (enclosing file, imports, and inheritance parents) to search for method definitions.
Extracts the bare symbol name from an import string, stripping callable markers and path prefixes.
Validates if a struct is a method and matches the provided name and optional arity.
Recursively searches for a method within a struct and its inheritance hierarchy, tracking visited UIDs to prevent infinite loops.
Identifies the type or scope UID associated with a method receiver by inspecting parent fields or module-level imports.
Retrieves the list of import candidates applicable to a given scope by checking the scope itself or its parent.
Normalizes a type reference string by stripping generic/array syntax and extracting the final identifier segment.
Determines if local scope search should be performed for a given dependency.
Orchestrates the dependency resolution process for a given method by attempting local scope search, receiver-based heuristic matching, and global import/inheritance lookups.
Locates methods matching a specific name and arity within a defined scope UID, or globally if no parent scope is provided.
Resolves a type name to a concrete struct UID by checking direct registry lookups, local file scope, and import candidates.

src/tostr/languages.description: Language-specific transformation layers for the tostr framework, providing specialized AST parsing, dependency resolution, and code generation logic for HTML, Python, and Java. Each module encapsulates language-aware builders that normalize syntax, manage structural mappings, and ensure cross-reference integrity during the conversion of tree-sitter nodes into target source code or markup.

src/tostr/languages/html.description: Implements HTML-specific document generation logic within the tostr framework. Orchestrates the transformation of AST nodes into structured HTML files, providing both atomic content processing via HtmlBuilder and lifecycle-managed file generation with integrity hashing via HtmlFileBuilder.

src/tostr/languages/html/__init__.py.description: Exposes the HtmlBuilder and HtmlFileBuilder classes from the builders module, serving as the primary entry point for the HTML generation package within the tostr framework.

src/tostr/languages/html/builders.py.description: Provides specialized builder implementations for HTML documents within the tostr framework. HtmlFileBuilder manages the lifecycle of HTML file objects, including integrity hashing and AST node generation, while HtmlBuilder provides a simplified, atomic processing interface for HTML content that bypasses granular dependency resolution.

src/tostr/languages/html/builders.py#Htm.description: Specialized builder for HTML documents that treats files as atomic units without structural decomposition into functions or classes, utilizing a no-op dependency resolver.
Instantiates and returns an HtmlFileBuilder configured with the current registry to process the HTML file structure.
Specialized file builder for HTML documents that extends BaseFileBuilder to populate file objects with parsed content, MD5 integrity hashes, and tree-sitter AST nodes for structural analysis.
Constructs a BaseFile instance from a filesystem path by reading the file content, generating an MD5 hash, and initializing a tree-sitter AST node for HTML structure parsing.

src/tostr/languages/java.description: Encapsulates the Java language support layer, providing a robust framework for AST-based code generation and dependency resolution. It leverages a suite of builder classes to transform tree-sitter nodes into structured Java components (classes, methods, fields, enums) while maintaining package normalization and cross-reference integrity through a specialized dependency resolver.

src/tostr/languages/java/__init__.py.description: Initializes the Java language module by exposing core builder classes (JavaBuilder, JavaFileBuilder, JavaClassBuilder, JavaMethodBuilder, JavaFieldBuilder, JavaEnumBuilder) and the JavaDependencyResolver for structured Java code generation and dependency management.

src/tostr/languages/java/builders.py.description: Provides a comprehensive suite of builder classes for parsing and structuring Java source code using tree-sitter. The module facilitates the transformation of AST nodes into standardized representations (files, classes, methods, fields, enums) while managing dependency tracking, package normalization, and UID generation for cross-referencing.

src/tostr/languages/java/builders.py#Jav.description: A factory class extending BaseBuilder that provides specialized builder instances for constructing Java source code components, including files, classes, methods, and fields, utilizing a shared registry for state management.
Instantiates and returns a JavaClassBuilder configured with the current registry.
Instantiates and returns a JavaFieldBuilder configured with the current registry.
Instantiates and returns a JavaFileBuilder configured with the current registry.
Instantiates and returns a JavaMethodBuilder configured with the current registry.
Specialized builder class for parsing Java class declarations from tree-sitter nodes into structured BaseClass objects, handling inheritance, modifiers, and nested member discovery.

Parses a Java class declaration node to construct a BaseClass instance, extracting metadata such as modifiers, type parameters, and inheritance relationships, then recursively processes the class body to register nested members.
A specialized builder for constructing Java enum representations from source code nodes, extending the base Java class construction logic.
Parses a source node to initialize an enum structure, currently serving as a placeholder for logic to extract and map enum constants to the class definition.
A specialized field builder for Java source code that parses AST nodes into structured BaseField objects, extracting modifiers, types, and identifiers to generate unique signatures and metadata.
Parses a Java field AST node to construct a BaseField instance, extracting modifiers, type, and name to build a canonical signature and unique identifier based on the parent context.

Specializes in parsing and constructing Java source file representations from filesystem paths using tree-sitter for structural analysis. It extracts package declarations, imports, and top-level code constructs like classes, interfaces, enums, and methods, registering them into a central registry.

Reads a Java source file, computes its MD5 hash, parses the AST via tree-sitter, and recursively populates the file object with metadata, imports, and child structural elements by delegating to specialized builders.
A specialized builder class for parsing Java method AST nodes into structured BaseMethod objects, handling signature extraction, parameter normalization for UID generation, and dependency tracking.

Parses a Java method AST node to construct a BaseMethod instance, extracting metadata including modifiers, type parameters, normalized parameter types for unique identification, and internal method call dependencies.

src/tostr/languages/java/builders.py#_ja.description: Generates a list of path-formatted UID candidates from a Java import FQN, mapping wildcard package imports to directory-scope markers and specific type imports to file-member UIDs.

src/tostr/languages/java/builders.py#_no.description: Canonicalizes a raw Java type string into a stable, erased form suitable for UID generation by stripping generics, converting varargs to arrays, collapsing whitespace, and removing package qualifiers.

src/tostr/languages/java/builders.py#_st.description: Extracts the simple class name from a fully qualified Java type by identifying the first uppercase-initial segment, effectively stripping package prefixes while preserving nested class structures.

src/tostr/languages/java/resolver.py.description: Specialized dependency resolver for Java projects that extends BaseDependencyResolver to leverage inherited scope-struct logic for artifact resolution.

src/tostr/languages/java/resolver.py#Jav.description: Specialized dependency resolver for Java projects that extends BaseDependencyResolver to leverage inherited scope-struct logic for artifact resolution.

src/tostr/languages/python.description: Encapsulates the Python-specific implementation of the tostr code generation framework, providing AST builders, dependency resolution logic, and structural mapping for Python source code. It handles the transformation of tree-sitter nodes into language-aware representations, manages Python-specific syntax nuances like 'self'/'cls' references, and normalizes import paths to support robust cross-reference resolution and project-wide analysis.

src/tostr/languages/python/__init__.py.description: Initializes the Python language module for the tostr framework, exposing core code generation components including PythonBuilder, file/class/method/field builders, and the PythonDependencyResolver for managing code structure and dependencies.

src/tostr/languages/python/builders.py.description: Implements language-specific AST builders for Python, extending the base framework to transform tree-sitter nodes into structured representations of files, classes, methods, and fields. The module provides specialized logic for Python-specific syntax, including inheritance resolution, UID generation, and import path normalization to facilitate cross-reference resolution within the project structure.

src/tostr/languages/python/builders.py#P.description: A factory class extending BaseBuilder that provides specialized builder instances for constructing Python-specific code structures including files, classes, methods, and fields using a shared registry.
Instantiates and returns a PythonClassBuilder configured with the current registry.
Instantiates and returns a PythonFieldBuilder configured with the current registry.
Instantiates and returns a PythonFileBuilder configured with the current registry.
Instantiates and returns a PythonMethodBuilder configured with the current registry.
Constructs BaseClass instances from tree-sitter Python class nodes, handling inheritance extraction, UID generation based on parent hierarchy, and recursive child parsing.
Parses a tree-sitter class node to instantiate a BaseClass, extracting the class name, inheritance list, and source body, while recursively populating child members via PythonFileBuilder.
Specialized builder for extracting and instantiating field definitions from Python source code nodes, mapping assignment expressions to structured BaseField objects.
Parses a Python AST node representing an assignment to extract field metadata, including name, type, and source bounds, and returns a fully initialized BaseField instance.
A specialized file builder for Python source code that parses files into structured objects, resolves module imports, handles aliased symbols, and recursively builds child structures from the AST.
Recursively traverses a structure to replace aliased dependency names with their original UIDs within method dependency lists.
Iterates through AST nodes to identify and instantiate Python-specific structures like classes, methods, and fields using dedicated builders.
Constructs a BaseFile object from a Python source file by reading content, calculating metadata, parsing the AST, resolving absolute and relative imports, and normalizing aliased dependencies.
Specialized builder for parsing Python method definitions from tree-sitter nodes, responsible for extracting metadata, calculating unique identifiers, and identifying internal dependencies.
Parses a tree-sitter node into a BaseMethod object by extracting the method name, signature, and arity, while generating a stable UID and identifying external method calls for dependency tracking.

src/tostr/languages/python/builders.py#_.description: Infers the source-root directory prefix for an absolute import by locating the first segment of the module path within the directory structure of the importing file.
Constructs a list of potential UID candidates for a member imported from a module, generating both standard and callable-signature variants for each possible module file path.
Generates a list of potential file-system paths for a given dotted module string, optionally prepending an anchor path to support heuristic-based resolution of source roots.

src/tostr/languages/python/resolver.py.description: Specializes dependency resolution for Python-specific syntax, handling 'self' and 'cls' references within class methods to map receivers to their corresponding type UIDs.

src/tostr/languages/python/resolver.py#P.description: Specializes dependency resolution for Python-specific syntax, handling 'self' and 'cls' references within class methods to map receivers to their corresponding type UIDs.
Initializes the resolver with a registry and sets the strict_arity flag to false for Python-specific flexibility.
Resolves the type UID of a receiver string by identifying 'self'/'cls' references or traversing parent class fields for attribute-based lookups.
Determines if local search is applicable for a dependency by checking if the receiver is absent or refers to 'self' or 'cls'.

src/tostr/semantic.description: Core semantic analysis layer providing infrastructure for LLM-based code interpretation and high-performance vector embedding generation. Orchestrates asynchronous workflows for structural codebase description, leveraging modular provider strategies for LLM interaction and hardware-accelerated ONNX inference for vectorization. Facilitates standardized semantic metadata extraction through a unified interface that balances intelligent generative analysis with lightweight structural serialization.

src/tostr/semantic/describer.py.description: Implements a hierarchical semantic description engine for codebase structures, providing both LLM-driven natural language generation and a lightweight structural fallback mechanism. The architecture utilizes a base class for asynchronous embedding management and lifecycle tracking, while specialized implementations handle either intelligent semantic analysis via LLM or direct metadata serialization for offline search indexing.

src/tostr/semantic/describer.py#LLMDescr.description: Orchestrates the generation of semantic descriptions for codebase structures (directories, files, classes, and methods) using LLM-based analysis, with a multi-tiered caching strategy that prioritizes existing descriptions from a lockfile to minimize redundant API calls.
Initializes the describer with an LLM client, an embedding client, and an optional lockfile containing previously committed structural metadata.
Updates methods with descriptions provided by the LLM response map and enqueues them for subsequent embedding.
Generates a description for a class by recursing on nested structures, seeding method descriptions from the lockfile, and batching undocumented methods for LLM analysis.
Generates a description for a directory by recursively processing its children or aggregating their descriptions, defaulting to 'Empty Directory' if no children exist.
Processes a file by recursing on non-method children, seeding method descriptions from the lockfile, and batching remaining undocumented methods for LLM-based description generation.
Generates a description for a childless file by sending its raw body content to the LLM for analysis.
Marks a method as described and queues it for embedding, intended for edge cases where a method is processed outside of a parent batch.
Attempts to populate a struct's description and vector from the lockfile if the struct's diff_hash matches the stored version, returning true on success.
Routes a structural element to its appropriate description handler based on type, ensuring the element is first seeded from the lockfile.

src/tostr/semantic/describer.py#NoLLMDes.description: A fallback implementation of the struct describer that bypasses LLM-based natural language generation, instead enqueuing structural metadata directly for embedding to maintain semantic search capabilities in offline or non-LLM modes.
Initializes the describer with an embedding client instance responsible for processing the enqueued structural data.
Recursively traverses the struct hierarchy, enqueuing non-field structs for embedding and continuing the walk through all child nodes.
Initiates the recursive traversal process starting from the provided root struct to enqueue all eligible components for embedding.

src/tostr/semantic/describer.py#_Describ.description: Provides shared infrastructure for embedding management and progress tracking within describer implementations, acting as a base class for handling asynchronous vectorization and lifecycle reporting.
Increments the progress tracker associated with the provided struct's registry for a specific phase by a given integer amount.
Evaluates the embedding status of a struct, either triggering a progress update if the vector exists or enqueuing the struct for processing via the configured embedder.

src/tostr/semantic/embeddings.description: Orchestrates high-throughput semantic vectorization of code structures through an extensible embedding architecture. Provides an abstract base for asynchronous processing and a specialized ONNX-based implementation that leverages Hugging Face tokenizers and ONNX Runtime for optimized, hardware-accelerated inference, including lifecycle management, batching, and post-processing normalization.

src/tostr/semantic/embeddings/base.py.description: Defines the foundational architecture for asynchronous text embedding generation, providing an abstract interface for embedding strategies and a robust client implementation that manages batch processing and thread-pool offloading for high-throughput vectorization of code structures.

src/tostr/semantic/embeddings/base.py#Em.description: Manages asynchronous batch processing of code structures for vector embedding generation. It utilizes a producer-consumer pattern to aggregate structures into batches, offloading compute-intensive embedding tasks to a thread pool while maintaining event-loop compatibility.
Initializes the client with a specific embedding strategy and an optional progress tracker.
Generates a string representation for a structure, prioritizing LLM-generated descriptions and falling back to code body, signature, or name to ensure semantic search signal.
Converts a batch of structures into text representations, computes embeddings via the strategy, updates the structures with resulting vectors, and signals task completion.
Executes the background consumer loop, aggregating structures into batches based on size or time constraints before triggering a flush.
Waits for all queued items to be processed and gracefully terminates the background worker task.
Adds a BaseStruct to the processing queue without blocking the caller.
Initializes the event-loop-bound queue and starts the background worker task.
An abstract base class defining a standardized interface for text embedding strategies, facilitating batch processing and query vectorization with configurable throughput parameters.
Initializes the strategy with parameters for batch processing throughput, specifically defining the maximum number of items per batch and the timeout duration for batch accumulation.
Returns the fixed dimensionality of the embedding vectors produced by the specific implementation.
Transforms a list of input strings into a corresponding list of high-dimensional embedding vectors.
Converts a single input query string into its corresponding embedding vector representation.

src/tostr/semantic/embeddings/onnx.py.description: Provides an ONNX-based embedding generation strategy that integrates Hugging Face tokenizers with ONNX Runtime for high-performance vectorization. The implementation encapsulates model lifecycle management, including asset caching, batch-processed tokenization, and post-inference vector refinement via mean pooling and L2 normalization.

src/tostr/semantic/embeddings/onnx.py#On.description: Implements an embedding strategy using ONNX Runtime and Hugging Face tokenizers to generate vector representations of text. It manages local caching of model assets, performs efficient batch tokenization, and executes inference via a pre-compiled ONNX graph with subsequent mean pooling and L2 normalization.
Initializes the strategy by configuring batch parameters, verifying the presence of required model assets, and loading the tokenizer and ONNX inference session.
Validates the existence and integrity of a cached asset file by comparing its current size against a predefined minimum threshold.
Ensures all required model files are present in the local cache, downloading them from the Hugging Face Hub if missing or incomplete.
Executes the core inference logic: tokenizes input text, runs the ONNX forward pass, applies mean pooling over the attention mask, and performs L2 normalization on the resulting vectors.
Returns the fixed dimensionality of the embedding vectors produced by the model.
Processes a batch of text descriptions into a list of normalized embedding vectors using the ONNX execution pipeline.
Generates a normalized embedding vector for a single query string by invoking the internal ONNX execution pipeline.

src/tostr/semantic/llm.description: Provides a modular, asynchronous framework for LLM-driven semantic analysis. It defines core abstractions for LLM interaction, including structured response modeling and concurrency management, while implementing provider-specific strategies for Gemini and Ollama to facilitate standardized, schema-enforced text generation across the application.

src/tostr/semantic/llm/__init__.py.description: Initializes the semantic LLM package by exposing core abstractions (LLMClient, LLMResponse, LLMStrategy), concrete provider implementations (GeminiStrategy, OllamaStrategy), and standardized system instruction constants for class, file, and directory processing.

src/tostr/semantic/llm/base.py.description: Provides a robust, asynchronous framework for LLM-based text generation, featuring structured response modeling, concurrency-controlled execution strategies, and resilient client orchestration with built-in error handling and rate-limiting.

src/tostr/semantic/llm/base.py#LLMClient.description: Orchestrates LLM-based text generation tasks by delegating execution to a configurable strategy, managing concurrency via semaphores, and implementing exponential backoff for transient network errors.
Initializes the client with a specific LLM execution strategy and an optional progress tracker for monitoring task completion.
Executes an asynchronous LLM generation request using the configured strategy, applying exponential backoff for 503 or 429 errors and updating the progress tracker upon successful completion.

src/tostr/semantic/llm/base.py#LLMRespon.description: A Pydantic data model representing a structured response from an LLM, encapsulating execution status, error details, and a mapping of child structural components to their respective descriptions.

src/tostr/semantic/llm/base.py#LLMStrate.description: Abstract base class defining a standardized interface and concurrency management mechanism for LLM interaction strategies, enforcing rate-limiting via an asynchronous semaphore.
Initializes the strategy with authentication credentials, target model identifier, and the maximum allowed concurrent request count.
Asynchronously executes an LLM generation request using the provided input, system instructions, and a Pydantic schema for structured output enforcement.
Provides lazy-initialized access to an asyncio.Semaphore instance, ensuring concurrent request execution does not exceed the configured threshold.

src/tostr/semantic/llm/gemini.py.description: Implements an LLM strategy for the Google Gemini API, providing structured content generation with schema enforcement via Pydantic models.

src/tostr/semantic/llm/gemini.py#GeminiS.description: Implements an LLM strategy for the Google Gemini API, providing structured content generation with schema enforcement via Pydantic models.
Initializes the Gemini client with the provided API key, model identifier, and concurrency constraints.
Executes an asynchronous content generation request to the Gemini API, enforcing a JSON schema on the output and returning a validated Pydantic model instance.

src/tostr/semantic/llm/ollama.py.description: Implements an LLM strategy for interacting with local or remote Ollama instances using an asynchronous client. It handles model auto-detection, configuration of generation parameters, and structured output parsing via Pydantic models.

src/tostr/semantic/llm/ollama.py#OllamaS.description: Implements an LLM strategy for interacting with local or remote Ollama instances using an asynchronous client. It handles model auto-detection, configuration of generation parameters, and structured output parsing via Pydantic models.
Initializes the Ollama client, auto-detecting the model if not provided, and configures the asynchronous client connection to the specified base URL.
Executes an asynchronous chat completion request to the Ollama API, enforcing a structured JSON response schema and returning a validated Pydantic model instance.

src/tostr/semantic/llm/prompts.py.description: This file is currently empty or contains no identifiable components or methods for analysis.

src/tostr/serializer.py.description: Provides a robust serialization framework for BaseStruct hierarchies, facilitating the transformation of complex code structures into standardized metadata formats. The module defines specialized containers for structural skeletons, detailed inspection results, and search-oriented entities, enabling recursive traversal and hierarchical representation of source code components for analysis and indexing purposes.

src/tostr/serializer.py#InspectResult.description: Represents a hierarchical metadata container for code analysis results, capturing structural information, relationships, and source code context for files, classes, and methods.

src/tostr/serializer.py#SearchResult.description: Represents a structured search result entity containing unique identifiers, classification metadata, and a similarity distance metric for vector or heuristic search operations.

src/tostr/serializer.py#SkeletonResult.description: Represents a recursive tree structure for skeleton-based data, typically used for hierarchical object modeling or skeletal animation hierarchies. Each instance acts as a node containing unique identifiers and a list of child nodes.

src/tostr/serializer.py#tost.description: A utility class providing serialization mechanisms for BaseStruct hierarchies, enabling recursive extraction of structural metadata (skeletons) or detailed inspection objects (full metadata with optional source bodies).

src/tostr/serializer.py#tost.dump(...).description: Recursively serializes a BaseStruct into an InspectResult, capturing structural metadata, dependency edges, and optional source code bodies up to a specified depth.

src/tostr/serializer.py#tost.dump_skelet.description: Generates a hierarchical skeleton of a BaseStruct, recursively traversing files, directories, and classes to produce a lightweight tree of SkeletonResult nodes, with optional filtering for file-only structures.

src/tostr/server.py.description: Provides the core server-side interface for the Tostr analysis engine, orchestrating project indexing, semantic search, and structural inspection. It manages workspace-specific file watchers via WatcherRegistry, handles configuration scaffolding, and exposes utility methods for formatting AST data and search results into LLM-consumable text representations.

src/tostr/server.py#WatcherRegistry.description: Manages a collection of isolated background file-watchers, keyed by absolute workspace path, to enable concurrent monitoring of multiple project directories within a stateless server architecture.

src/tostr/server.py#WatcherRegistry.__in.description: Initializes an empty registry for tracking project-specific watcher threads and their associated event loops.

src/tostr/server.py#WatcherRegistry._run.description: Executes an isolated asyncio event loop to run the asynchronous file-watching logic, handling lifecycle cleanup upon completion or failure.

src/tostr/server.py#WatcherRegistry.star.description: Starts or restarts a dedicated background thread for monitoring the specified path, replacing any existing watcher for that location.

src/tostr/server.py#WatcherRegistry.stop.description: Signals the specified project's watcher to stop via its event loop and joins the associated thread to ensure clean resource deallocation.

src/tostr/server.py#_parse_list_input(...description: Normalizes varied input formats (JSON strings, comma-separated strings, or lists) into a consistent list of strings.

src/tostr/server.py#_render_inspect(...).description: Serializes an InspectResult object into a structured, human-readable text block containing metadata, dependency edges, child members, and the source code body.

src/tostr/server.py#_render_search(...).description: Formats a list of search results into a concise, readable string representation for output.

src/tostr/server.py#_render_skeleton(....description: Recursively traverses a SkeletonResult tree to generate a formatted string representation of the project structure.

src/tostr/server.py#_resolve_workspace(..description: Validates that a provided path is absolute and exists on the filesystem, raising a TostrError if validation fails.

src/tostr/server.py#_short_uid(...).description: Normalizes a UID by stripping the redundant file path prefix, retaining only the member-specific identifier.

src/tostr/server.py#clean(...).description: Deletes the project's Tostr cache and stops its associated background watcher, with an optional flag to purge configuration files.

src/tostr/server.py#export(...).description: Exports LLM-generated code descriptions to a tostr.lock.json file to facilitate collaborative caching and minimize redundant API usage.

src/tostr/server.py#init(...).description: Scaffolds project configuration files (tostr.toml, .tostrignore) to enable user-defined customization of the Tostr analysis process.

src/tostr/server.py#inspect_by_id(...).description: Retrieves and formats AST details and code bodies for specific struct IDs, serving as the primary interface for deep-diving into implementation.

src/tostr/server.py#inspect_by_uid(...).description: Retrieves and formats AST details and code bodies for specific struct UIDs, supporting dependency visualization and optional code inclusion.

src/tostr/server.py#parse(...).description: Initializes project analysis by resolving the workspace path, triggering AST parsing and semantic embedding generation, and activating a background file watcher to maintain cache consistency.

src/tostr/server.py#search(...).description: Executes a semantic search against the project's vector embeddings to identify relevant code structs based on natural language queries.

src/tostr/server.py#skeleton(...).description: Generates a hierarchical text representation of the project's AST for a specified subpath, providing an architectural overview.

src/tostr/storage.description: Centralizes persistent storage and state management for the Tostr architecture, orchestrating SQLite-based graph persistence, vector embedding storage, and atomic JSON-based metadata caching. It enforces schema integrity and version compatibility through automated migration utilities and deterministic lockfile management, ensuring consistent state reconciliation for LLM-driven code analysis workflows.

src/tostr/storage/cache.py.description: Provides a persistent caching layer for code structures using SQLite, facilitating efficient storage, retrieval, and reconciliation of struct metadata and embeddings to optimize LLM-based processing workflows.

src/tostr/storage/cache.py#StructCache.description: Acts as the persistence layer for the struct registry, managing SQLite-backed storage, retrieval, and reconciliation of code structures. It handles hydration of structs from the database, incremental updates via pruning, and caching mechanisms to avoid redundant LLM-based description generation or embedding calculations.

src/tostr/storage/cache.py#StructCache._.description: Initializes the cache with project paths, a registry store, and configuration flags for caching and lockfile usage.
Removes specified struct IDs and their associated edges and vector data from the database.
Deletes structs under a specific file path that are not present in the provided set of kept IDs, ensuring the cache remains synchronized with the filesystem.

src/tostr/storage/cache.py#StructCache.c.description: Reuses cached descriptions and vectors for structs whose body hash matches the current state, preventing redundant processing for unchanged code.
Extracts all valid, non-stale struct descriptions and optional vectors from the cache into a UID-keyed map for lockfile export.

src/tostr/storage/cache.py#StructCache.d.description: Deletes all structs and associated data belonging to a specific file or directory path from the database.
